messages:
michelle: Pulled the postmortem into a focused action thread. I split long-running items into ownerable tickets. Please confirm you can take and give realistic ETAs.

dan: I can pick up the eviction-safe cache fallback work (INF-902). Need 10 working days to run load matrices and a small canary.

rana: I'll own the autoscaler bug and its regression suite (INF-903). Plan: write tests by next Tue, PR by end of week.

michelle: Current tickets: INF-902 (dan) - prefix/KV fallback + canary; INF-903 (rana) - autoscaler bug + tests; SEC-318 (igor) - KMS audit + rotation policy; OPS-209 (lee) - runbook + alert tuning; COMM-77 (vika) - customer note + postmortem publish.

igor: SEC-318 ok, but need export of KMS logs for the last 60 days. @lee can you confirm access to the logs bucket?

lee: Logs are in `s3://redwood-audit-exports/2024/06/`. Gave igor read role. Also added a short glue job to unzip and filter.

vika: COMM-77 ack. Will draft external note and include impacted customers list. ETA: Thu morning.

michelle: RACI: owners are Responsible. Please reply with Accountable (manager) and who should be Consulted/Informed. Will escalate missing replies after 24h.

dan: Accountable INF-902: nate (team lead). Consulted: eng-sre. Informed: ops.

rana: Accountable INF-903: rana. Consulted: runtime + infra. Informed: product.

michelle: Added a label `pattern: eviction+autoscale` to postmortem and tickets since this interaction repeated in April and May. Tagging for QBR.

calendar-bot: [event created] Postmortem action sync (15m) weekly starting 2024-06-12T17:00:00Z. Invite sent to participants.

igor: Quick ask  if anyone sees blockers around infra access or test data, flag here so we can unblock.

lee: I'll run the canary with reduced traffic on staging and report perf numbers in INF-902.

michelle: Thanks. I'll create sub-tasks for verification criteria (smoke checks, perf delta thresholds) and mark acceptance criteria on each Jira. Will close loop when all tickets have accountable owners and ETAs. :thumbsup:
